question: Women's World Boxing Championship 2023 was held in which city in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Women's World Boxing Championship 2023** was held in **New Delhi**, India.
 
• This event brought together the best women boxers from around the world to compete for the championship titles.
 
• New Delhi has previously hosted several international sporting events, showcasing its capability to organize events of such magnitude.
 
• The championship serves as a platform for women boxers to demonstrate their skills and gain international recognition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **New Delhi** is the capital city of India and a prominent center for political, cultural, and sporting events.
 
• The city has a rich history and is known for its heritage sites, including the India Gate, Red Fort, and Qutub Minar.
 
• Hosting international events like the Women's World Boxing Championship helps in promoting sports and encouraging young athletes, especially women, to pursue their dreams.
 
• India has been increasingly focusing on developing sports infrastructure and providing support to athletes to excel at global platforms.
 
• The success of such events contributes to the overall growth and development of sports in the country.
